from pathlib import Path
import json,sys
data=json.loads(sys.argv[1])
source=Path('gobreaker.go').read_text().splitlines()
def citation(n):
 return dict(file='gobreaker.go',line=n,fragment=source[n-1])
def save(name,obj):
 Path('analysis',name).write_text(json.dumps(obj,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
initial=Path('analysis/initial.json')
baseline=json.loads(initial.read_text())
added=[dict(id=i,initial=start,steps=steps,outcome=outcome,citation=citation(n),test=t,question=q) for i,start,steps,outcome,n,t,q in data['findings']]
text=initial.read_text()
tail='\n  ]\n}'
end=text.rindex(tail)
encoded=json.dumps(added,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False).splitlines()[1:-1]
Path('analysis/final.json').write_text(text[:end]+',\n'+'\n'.join('  '+line for line in encoded)+text[end:])
assert json.loads(Path('analysis/final.json').read_text())['findings']==baseline['findings']+added
save('supplement.json',dict(qualifications=[dict(id=i,status='qualified',rationale=why,citation=citation(n)) for i,n,why in data['qualifications']],test_bindings=[dict(id=i,test=t,scope=s) for i,t,s in data['bindings']]))
save('final-checks.json',[dict(id=f'C{i}',kind='claim',statement=s,line=n,fragment=source[n-1]) for i,(s,n) in enumerate(data['checks'],1)])
